controls: A/B differ only thinking_budget, which also maps to effort. A/C differ only registered method prompt. New samples/time are not exact reproduction or stable-effect proof. Production settings are unchanged.

predeclaredReadout.lateCompletion: A first answer after 300s, complete DONE/stop: naturally completing reasoning exceeds interactive deadline.
predeclaredReadout.budgetContribution: B earlier first answer and fewer reasoning tokens than A; any final-quality changes reported against frozen source/gold, not hidden.
predeclaredReadout.experienceContribution: Compare A/C extra computations, reasoning tokens and time; one sample is directional, not a stable causal-effect estimate.
predeclaredReadout.degeneration: Require observable repeated long passages/calculation cycles, not mere length or compression.

qualityScope: AI source checking under original rubric; no release acceptance or automatic selection.
